_readme: Fact universe for the golden retrieval benchmark. One fictional user (Ana Ruiz). Facts are seeded with these exact ids so cases.json can assert on them. Fields: id, text, optional valid_from/valid_to (ISO-8601, for bi-temporal supersession cases), optional entities (labels the graph channel should link), optional superseded_by.

facts.text: Ana's dog is a wire-haired dachshund called Biscuit.
Biscuit sees a vet named Dr. Okonjo at the Fairview clinic.
Biscuit is allergic to chicken and eats a lamb-based food instead.
Ana's flatmate has a tabby cat called Marbles.
Ana runs every Tuesday morning before work.
